title: Queue pause reason: behaviour tests for the runtime-exit reason, cleanup-failure precedence and latch preservation
acceptance: Deterministic behaviour tests cover a mailbox-woken turn's runtime exit naming runtime_exited with failureKind runtime_crashed when no typed kind was reported, a runtime exit whose cleanup owner is retained naming runtime_cleanup_failed, and an exit under an existing quarantine or dedicated hold keeping the earlier reason; and the provider-capacity cause precedence is exercised through the real capacity-failure path.
